title: Taupe Pebbled Structured Day Tote
description: A structured tote in soft taupe pebbled faux leather with twin rolled top handles. Gold-tone side rings allow for an extra shoulder strap, and the roomy body holds everyday essentials with ease.
seo_description: Taupe pebbled faux leather tote with twin handles and gold-tone side rings, a smart everyday bag for work and weekends.
